title: Zero, Halves and Dozens
label: ch:cero-y-mitad
canDo: I can say cero, el numero, la mitad, la docena and doble, and say why English borrowed the same Arabic word twice, as zero and as cipher.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C344-doble: count from zero, name the number itself, halve a thing, count it by twelves, and double it.
